question: Should ClawSweeper own this named-operator Cloudflare Access and cross-repository credential bootstrap authority?
rationale: Tests can validate fail-closed mechanics, but they cannot decide the intended production operator, GitHub App scope, or repository ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve the staged authority
options.body: Accept the named operator and scoped publication model while keeping all consumers dormant until a separately reviewed atomic cutover.

options.title: Move bootstrap ownership
options.body: Place Cloudflare Access reconciliation and credential publication in separately governed infrastructure while ClawSweeper remains only a consumer.

recommendation.title: Approve the staged authority
recommendation.body: Accept the named operator and scoped publication model while keeping all consumers dormant until a separately reviewed atomic cutover.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history and workflow identity binding show direct ownership of the proposed operational boundary.
